data.summary:
Results-driven Project Manager and Business Analyst with 1 5+ years progressive experience in the Banking, Insurance, Finance and Accounting; certified PMP, RPA Program Manager, and Six Sigma Green Belt. Expert in leading Digital transformations, AI/RPA-driven 
Result driven leader with 1 5+ years of experience in Digital Transformation. Expertly led digital initiatives within banking, Finance ans accounting sector, specialising in AI-driven solution delivery, RPA implementation, and process automation.
Engineered AI-based solutions resulting in 750K Euro savings for securities processes by converting unstructured data into structured formats. Successfully delivered enterprise-wide projects, including deployment of a
transaction screening workflow across 26 countries to mitigate risk and enhance operational controls.

RPA implementations (UiPath, Automation Anywhere, Blue Prism) and 20 FTEs from static data and account opening automation.
Directed end-to-end ERP Implementations (MS Dynamics, SAP), automating PTP, RTR, and OTC processes, and integrating systems like Ariba and Coupa. Proficient in data analysis, data migration, and leveraging tools like Tableau for enhanced reporting and decision-making, delivering 1 0 FTE benefits through report automation.
PMP, RPA Program Manager (Automation Anywhere), and Six Sigma Green Belt
certified, demonstrating commitment to project management excellence and continuous improvement.
